Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to refuse, decline', paired with 'отказаться'.

Подожди! = wait!. Prefix 'под-' ('under, up to') indicates approaching or supporting from below (stem 'ождать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to wait (a while)', paired with 'ждать'.
